verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a real banner (can on the left, two-line headline in the centre, CTA on the right), so the hierarchy holds. Its flaws: the legal line is far too small to read, the sticker placeholder is crammed against it below the headline, and the can and CTA sit almost against the left and right edges while the logo is small. B just shrinks the square layout into the middle of the strip: the logo and the can's label can't be read, the headline and CTA are tiny, the legal text is a smudge, and huge empty areas sit on both sides, with the sticker left floating on the right.
